card.name: Instruction words in dosing directions
card.fires_on: Words in directions about how to handle or give a drug, such as 'use a' before a syringe, 'do not crush', 'consider' before dose reduction, and 'dress' in occlusive dressings.

modes.label: Measuring device directions
modes.description: The word 'a' after 'always use' ahead of an oral syringe or measuring cup.
modes.example: Strongly advise patients and caregivers to always use<< a>> graduated oral syringe or measuring cup,

modes.label: Do-not and consider verbs
modes.description: Verbs that give a handling or dose instruction, such as crush or consider.
modes.example: • Do not<< crush>> or chew the capsules.

modes.label: Occlusive dressing wording
modes.description: The word dress or dressings after 'occlusive' in topical directions.
modes.example: Do not use OPZELURA with occlusive<< dress>>ings. ( 2.1 )
